evals.prompt: Our assistant uses the http_api_read schemas from kei-agents for our CRM. Do those reads execute in kei-proxy identity mode, do I need a crm provider, and should I put the CRM base URL in the binding config?
evals.expected_output: CRM is an http_api connector named crm; there is no separate crm provider. The http_api_read tool definitions in kei-agents do not change: delegated_context stays tenant_id and the base URL never goes into binding config (validation rejects it). In identity mode kei-proxy serve runs the http_api call from the bundle's non-secret descriptor and injects the API key; the agent never reads the credential.
